meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你诊断容器化代理系统的问题。它会检查日志、数据库和挂载点，找出容器失败、认证错误或消息丢失的原因。
howto.when: 当容器代理不工作、容器启动失败、出现认证问题，或者你想了解容器系统如何运作时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看为什么容器代理没有回复消息。
检查一下是否有重复的 NanoClaw 服务实例在运行。
say.note: Claude 会运行 ps aux 命令来检测重复进程。

say.text: 重启 agent group 的容器并重建镜像。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help diagnose issues with the containerized agent system. It checks logs, databases, and mounts to find causes of container failures, authentication errors, or lost messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when container agents are not working, containers fail to start, authentication problems occur, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: Check why the container agent is not replying.
say_en.note: Claude inspects inbound.db and outbound.db to locate the issue.

say_en.text: Check for duplicate NanoClaw service instances.
say_en.note: Claude runs ps aux to detect duplicate processes.

say_en.text: Restart the agent group container and rebuild the image.
